description: issue #679 (SP7): the OFF half of the reserved-word profile gate. The same three `define`s are ACCEPTED under `core-language` alone, because `tell`/`ask`/`each` are reserved only within the Sprites profile and are deliberately not in the Core reserved-word list (spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154). A Core program that already uses those names keeps working until it opts into Sprites.
